Keep this app open in the foreground and the phone unlocked until pairing is complete.

The first values appear shortly afterwards. From now on the app keeps running in the background.

The app forwards the pump\'s alarms and alerts as soon as the pump reports them. You still have to clear them on the pump.
Urgent alarms (“Urgent low”, urgent pump alerts) use the channel “Urgent alarms”. Whether they break through Do Not Disturb is set in the Android settings of this channel.
Android settings › Apps › iPump-mini › Notifications: allow, sound on for “Alarms” and “Urgent alarms”.
So urgent alarms get through at night: enable “Override Do Not Disturb” for the channel “Urgent alarms”, or add iPump-mini as an exception under Do Not Disturb › Apps.
Tap “Send test alarm”, lock the phone and check that the alarm appears with sound. Individual alarms can be muted for 15, 30 or 60 minutes from the notification.

iPump-mini (project openMinipump) is not a medical device and not intended for therapy decisions. The pump\'s displays and alarms are always authoritative. The app only reads from the pump and cannot change settings or deliver insulin. Use at your own responsibility.

All data stays on this phone. The app sends nothing to Medtronic or CareLink and nothing to the developers. It only connects to the internet when you turn on the Nightscout upload or load the key database (GitHub). By default the local API is only reachable on this device; sharing it on Wi-Fi is optional and protected by an API secret.
iPump-mini is a private, non-commercial open-source project. The app reads data from a MiniMed 780G series insulin pump via Bluetooth and displays it. It is for information and convenience only.
The app is not a medical device and has no approval and no CE marking. It must not be used for therapy or treatment decisions, for example to calculate or deliver insulin or to treat a low.

The displays, values and alarms of the pump and the sensor are always authoritative. The pump\'s alarms must stay turned on. The alarms of this app are a non-binding supplement and do not replace the pump\'s alarms.

Displayed values may be wrong, outdated or incomplete. The app can stop working at any time, for example when Android terminates it, the Bluetooth connection drops, the phone is silenced, Do Not Disturb is active, notifications are turned off or the battery is empty. Alarms may arrive late, silently or not at all.
The app is built so that it sends no commands that change the pump\'s therapy, settings or state. There is no guarantee that the connection does not change the pump\'s behaviour in any way.

The project is not affiliated with Medtronic and is neither supported nor reviewed by Medtronic. MiniMed, SmartGuard, Guardian, Simplera and CareLink are trademarks of their owners. Using the app may affect the manufacturer\'s warranty or support terms; checking this is up to you.

The data stays on your phone. The developers receive no data. It only leaves the device if you turn on the Nightscout upload or the local API on Wi-Fi yourself; you are responsible for that.
You use the app at your own responsibility and check yourself whether its use is permitted in your country. Talk to your diabetes team about questions regarding your therapy.

The app needs the key database once for the encrypted connection. Settings › Pump › Key database › “Load from OpenMinimed”.
The pump accepts only one mobile device. Remove a pairing with MiniMed Mobile on the pump first. Then open “Pair pump” in the app and follow the instructions.
Simplera Sync has no transmitter, Guardian 4 does. This determines which values are shown.

A service with a permanent notification keeps the app reachable so the pump can connect at any time. The notification shows the current value. Turn off battery optimisation for iPump-mini (Settings › Pump).
Without Bluetooth the pump cannot connect. After turning it back on, the pump reconnects by itself.
Bring the pump in range and open the app. If that does not help after a few minutes, turn Bluetooth off and on again. Only pair again if that does not help either.
The app\'s alarms are a supplement. Always keep the pump\'s alarms turned on.
Optional: uploads values, pump status and treatments to your own Nightscout. URL and API secret under Settings › Nightscout.
Nightscout-compatible interface on port 17580, for watches and other apps. On Wi-Fi only with an API secret.
